campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for every perfume.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images must represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: The perfume bottle establishes the physical scale of the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: All surrounding olfactive elements must be physically and visually proportional to the reference bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Use realistic real-world proportions between the perfume bottle and every surrounding ingredient.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Oversized ingredients are not permitted for this fragrance.

fragrance_data.name: Agua de Vetiver (YLY)
fragrance_data.description: Agua de Vetiver (YLY) is a fresh masculine perfume that combines an initial feeling of freshness with a deep and sensual base. Geranium, incense and vetiver create a clean, aromatic fragrance with a warm, sophisticated and slightly smoky dry-down.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Realistic red geranium flowers and green stems
selected_visual_notes.reason: The geranium is explicitly described as a refined floral-green element that gives structure and modern masculine character to the fragrance.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A small group of realistic red geranium flowers placed naturally beside and slightly behind the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Individual geranium flowers and petals suspended dynamically around the floating bottle.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Realistic vetiver roots and fine green grass-like leaves
selected_visual_notes.reason: Vetiver is one of the defining notes of the fragrance and communicates its earthy, woody and sophisticated character.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A small cluster of realistic vetiver roots and foliage integrated naturally into the still life.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Fine vetiver roots and leaves suspended around the bottle with subtle movement.

selected_visual_notes.reason: Incense contributes to the deep, sophisticated and slightly smoky character described in the product description.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Very subtle smoke in the background, never obscuring the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled ribbon of translucent smoke flowing around the suspended bottle.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small pieces of natural cedar wood
selected_visual_notes.reason: Cedar reinforces the dry woody character of the base and provides a physical structural material for the composition.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: One or two small cedar fragments integrated into the surface composition.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small cedar fragments suspended with restrained movement.

selected_visual_notes.reason: Juniper reinforces the fresh, aromatic and clean character of the fragrance.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A small cluster of juniper berries placed near the botanical elements.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few individual juniper berries floating around the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.reason: Bergamot contributes to the fresh and luminous opening but should remain secondary to the fragrance's green and woody identity.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small suspended peel fragments with subtle movement.

shared_visual_identity.concept: A sophisticated masculine fragrance that moves visually from a fresh, luminous green opening into a deep woody and subtly smoky atmosphere.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Express the duality described by the fragrance: light and fresh on the surface, intense and sophisticated underneath.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: Cool, refined and natural masculine atmosphere combining botanical freshness with mineral and woody depth.

editorial_still_life.concept: A refined botanical and woody still life where the perfume bottle rests on a natural stone surface surrounded by carefully selected green and red botanical elements, cedar wood and subtle incense smoke.

environment.description: A sophisticated cool-toned environment with a natural stone surface, subtle botanical depth and a softly atmospheric background.
environment.background_rule: The background should feel like a premium photographic environment rather than a generic landscape.

rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Text must integrate naturally with the composition.
Do not overload the image with text.

immersive_surreal.concept: The same fresh botanical and woody fragrance identity transformed into a dynamic atmospheric scene, with the perfume bottle suspended in space while geranium, vetiver, juniper, cedar and incense smoke move naturally around it.

environment.description: A cool green-grey cinematic environment with subtle mineral depth and controlled atmospheric smoke.

negative_constraints: no typography in the immersive surreal image
